definitions.gloss: detached house; standalone house; single-family home
definitions.explanation: A house that stands on its own, not connected to other buildings — as opposed to an apartment or row house. Also can refer to a solitary house standing alone in an isolated location. Composed of 一 (one) + 軒 (house counter) + 家 (house).

examples.japanese: {一軒家|いっけんや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}みたい→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I want to live in a detached house.

examples.japanese: ⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{一軒家|いっけんや}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{持|も}てる→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: With a detached house you can have a garden, unlike an apartment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ぽつん⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{一軒家|いっけんや}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{建|た}っていた→建つ：12544_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: A solitary house stood alone in the mountains.

notes:
USAGE:
{一軒家|いっけんや} is commonly used when discussing housing choices — detached house vs. apartment (⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧). In real estate, it is a standard category.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一軒家|いっけんや}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{建|た}てる→建てる：01189_tateru⟧ (to build a detached house)
- {一軒家|いっけんや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧ (to live in a detached house)
- ⟦{中古|ちゅうこ}→中古：03479_chuuko⟧{一軒家|いっけんや} (secondhand detached house)
- ぽつん⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{一軒家|いっけんや} (a solitary house — also the title of a popular TV show)

CULTURAL NOTE:
The TV show 「ポツン⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{一軒家|いっけんや}」 features visits to isolated houses in remote mountain locations across Japan, and has popularized the image of a lone house in the wilderness.
